verdict.rationale: Cake Equity is a cap-table management SaaS, not an AI agent or assistant, so consuming MCP servers as an MCP client is outside its product role. The evidence shows only the opposite role: Cake exposes its own read-only MCP server that external clients like Claude, Codex or Cursor connect to. That server-side capability does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
